description: Sync a project folder into the hub. Collects git facts automatically; pass digest (your own summary of state/next steps) and the card is rewritten.

agent.description: the function you are performing, e.g. "dev-hubd". NOT which model you are — that is read from the transcript, and many sessions share a model. NOT a queue role either: a role is a mailbox (see hub_queue_wait), this is who is at it.

digest.description: Agent-written summary: status, recent work, next steps, blockers

path.description: Absolute path to the project folder

name: hub_sync
